src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s:
Consider the following statements:
I. India's first National Highway steel slag road section is on NH-66 Mumbai-Goa National Highway.
II. Steel slag technology was developed by the Indian Green Building Council (IGBC) and Central Road Research Institute (CRRI).
III. JSW Steel, under the IGBC-CRRI technological guidance, has constructed a 1 km long four lane steel slag road section on NH-66 Mumbai-Goa National Highway.
Which of the above given statements is / are correct?
x: Statement I is correct: the first steel-slag road on a National Highway is on NH-66 (Mumbai-Goa). Statement II is wrong because the technology was by CSIR-CRRI, not IGBC. Statement III is not supported, so only I is correct.

src: APPSC

x: Google's Bengaluru tech campus launched in February 2025 is called Ananta, so option 2 is correct.

src: APPSC
s: Identify the only correct pair from the recent innovations and initiatives in India (2025).
o: Startup launching India’s first private satellite constellation – Skyroot Aerospace
Battery-sharing initiative for rural farmers – Ola Electric
AI automation investment to reduce hospital workload – Fortis Healthcare
First state to telecast Assembly in sign language – Punjab
x: The notes do not state the sign-language telecast fact. Punjab is the correct pair as given. The other pairs are wrong: Skyroot is known for the private orbital rocket Vikram-1, not a satellite constellation.

src: APPSC Sample Taker 2023
